## This repository is a generated mirror

`trulioo-mcp/`, `attest-plugin.mjs`, `server.json`, `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`,
`CONTRIBUTING.md`, `SECURITY.md`, and the marketplace catalogs are published output.
They are produced from Trulioo's MCP server repository and replaced by CI on every
release.

**A pull request against those paths cannot be merged.** The next release overwrites
it, and in the meantime an edit invalidates the KYA attestation that seals the payload
- so a typo fix turns a verifiable bundle into one that fails `--verify`.

If you came here to fix something in them, please
[open an issue](https://github.com/Trulioo/trulioo-mcp/issues/new/choose) instead. Name
the file and quote the line; that maps straight onto the generated source, and we add a
test so it cannot come back. See
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Trulioo/trulioo-mcp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
